start.title: The Appointed Mountain
start.text:
You climb to the place He named.
Galilee opens wide beneath your feet.

choices.text: Linger below in fear of meeting
Climb expecting empty silence
Climb with hope to meet Him

linger_consequence.title: Do Not Linger
linger_consequence.text:
Fear waits at the foot of mountains.
Hope waits at the top.

choices.text: Climb with hope to meet Him

empty_consequence.title: Not Empty
empty_consequence.text:
He keeps every promise He makes.
Climb. He will be there.

choices.text: Climb with hope to meet Him

worship.title: He Is There
worship.text:
He stands above you, radiant and calm.
Some doubt. Most fall down.

choices.text: Stand back, arms folded in doubt
Bow low. Worship the Lord
Ask Him for personal reward
choices.feedback: This is not the hour for that.

doubt_consequence.title: Step Closer
doubt_consequence.text:
Doubt cannot hold against His face.
Kneel. He is the Lord.

choices.text: Bow low. Worship the Lord

reward_consequence.title: Not for Reward
reward_consequence.text:
He gives more than gold can name.
Worship first. Receive after.

choices.text: Bow low. Worship the Lord

authority.title: All Authority
authority.text:
"All authority in heaven and on earth
has been given to Me," He says.

choices.text: Argue Rome still holds the world
choices.feedback: His reign is deeper than Rome.

choices.text: Demand He prove it with a sign
Receive His word in awe

argue_consequence.title: Higher Than Rome
argue_consequence.text:
Empires rise. Empires fall.
His kingdom outlasts them all.

choices.text: Receive His word in awe

demand_consequence.title: No Sign Needed
demand_consequence.text:
He stands risen before your eyes.
What sign is greater?

choices.text: Receive His word in awe

go_nations.title: Go and Make Disciples
go_nations.text:
"Go therefore and make disciples
of all the nations," He says.

choices.text: Keep this gift only for Israel
Hide it among trusted friends
Say yes. Go to every nation
choices.feedback: Your heart widens to the world.

israel_consequence.title: Not Only One People
israel_consequence.text:
His love crosses every border.
Go to all the nations.

choices.text: Say yes. Go to every nation

hide_consequence.title: Do Not Hide
hide_consequence.text:
This light is for the whole earth.
Carry it into the open.

choices.text: Say yes. Go to every nation

baptize.title: Baptizing Them
baptize.text:
"Baptizing them in the name of
the Father, the Son, and the Spirit."

choices.text: Baptize only the worthy few
Baptize all who believe in Him
Charge a price for the rite

worthy_consequence.title: All Who Believe
worthy_consequence.text:
No one is worthy on their own.
All are welcomed by His name.

choices.text: Baptize all who believe in Him

price_consequence.title: Freely Received
price_consequence.text:
Freely you have received.
Freely give. No price at all.

choices.text: Baptize all who believe in Him
choices.feedback: You let go of every coin.

teach.title: Teaching Them
teach.text:
"Teaching them to obey all I
have commanded you," He says.

choices.text: Teach only what is easy to hear
choices.feedback: Teach all He commanded. Not less.

choices.text: Add your own rules to His
choices.feedback: Do not add. Do not subtract.

choices.text: Teach all He has commanded

easy_consequence.title: Teach It All
easy_consequence.text:
Soft truth is no truth at all.
Give them the whole gospel.

choices.text: Teach all He has commanded

add_consequence.title: Add Nothing
add_consequence.text:
His commands are enough.
Do not burden what He made light.

choices.text: Teach all He has commanded
choices.feedback: You set your own rules aside.

presence.title: I Am With You
presence.text:
"And surely I am with you always,
to the very end of the age."

choices.text: Fear the road without His face
Trust His Spirit goes with you
Wait on the mountain forever
choices.feedback: The world is the field. Go.

fear_consequence.title: Always With You
fear_consequence.text:
He has not left. He will not leave.
Walk in His unseen presence.

choices.text: Trust His Spirit goes with you

wait_consequence.title: Do Not Wait
wait_consequence.text:
The nations are waiting for you.
Descend. Begin the work.

choices.text: Trust His Spirit goes with you

ending.title: Sent Into the World
ending.text:
You descend the mountain together.
The world is wide. He goes with you.
